Applicants to this cohort will be eligible to receive up to $500,000 USD in funding over three years—without giving up equity.

You’re probably familiar with the concept of “product market-fit,” the idea that if products satisfy a need in the market and build momentum in attracting users, they can reach a kind of tipping point that allows them to successfully sell their product. [...] For our next Incubator cohort, Mozilla Foundation is investing in this alternative trajectory for AI. We call it Human-Scale AI: bespoke, fit-for-purpose technology designed at the scale of the problem it's meant to solve. Building AI systems that people don’t hate starts with a different kind of funding—capital that supports a project’s potential for impact, not just scale. We intend to prove that AI can solve real problems well without having to follow the extractive, scale-at-all-costs model [...] Projects that demonstrate strong progress may be eligible for up to $200,000 USD in additional funding and two more years of bespoke support—bringing the total potential support to $500,000 USD over three years. Follow-on funding will consider progress on the core technology, evidence of product-community fit, meaningful public benefit, and a clear roadmap for what another two years of support could unlock.
